errors.text_span: Секторът за "Концесии за добив на минерална вода" е окачен в лилаво и представлява 0,7%
errors.evidence: The description states that the "Concessions for mineral water extraction" sector accounts for 0.7%, but the chart and legend show it is 2.2%.
The phrase "е окачен в лилаво" is awkward phrasing in Bulgarian, translating roughly to "is hung in purple". A more natural phrasing would be "е оцветен в лилаво" (is colored purple).
